references.text: The principle of lex talionis: 'eye for eye, tooth for tooth' - the same law of retribution establishing that punishment must correspond to the harm inflicted.
Reiterates the law of retribution: 'life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot' - the same legal principle of proportional punishment.
Jesus quotes this law and offers a new interpretation: instead of retaliation, he encourages turning the other cheek.
The principle that one should be judged by the same measure used to judge others - a spiritual application of the retribution principle.
Continuation of the same legal text specifying 'fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth' - elaborates on the principle in verse 19.
